title: Vesper and the Homecoming
author: Wendell Winterbourne
blurb: Jonah Iversen, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must expose what the school board buried before prom.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
